name: How quickly do I need to address storm damage to my home or business?

mainEntity.name: How quickly do I need to address storm damage to my home or business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timely action is crucial to minimize secondary damage. Water damage, for instance, can lead to mold growth within 24-48 hours. Structural issues can worsen quickly, posing safety risks. Contacting a restoration company promptly after the storm allows for immediate mitigation, which can significantly reduce repair costs and protect your property from long-term issues. Delays can also impact insurance claims.
acceptedAnswer.description: Address storm damage immediately to prevent secondary issues like mold and to minimize repair costs and insurance claim complications.
